1.stem_plain: Emma noticed her younger brother ________ the last cookie from the jar and putting it into his lunchbox.

2.stem_plain: The children continued with their nature walk, ________ of the weather.

3.stem_plain: "I am such a helpful friend, ________ I?" Sheila bragged.

4.stem_plain: Neither Tom nor the twins ________ attending the camp this weekend.

5.stem_plain: Since fewer people attended the event, there was ________ work for the volunteers to do.

6.stem_plain: The footpath runs ________ the river and the playground.

7.stem_plain: Felix, ________ carefully to the instructions, completed the task without any mistakes.

8.stem_plain: Our floorball players' performance was a great one. In fact, it was ________ we had ever put up.

9.stem_plain: By the time the audience members were seated, the musicians ________ their instruments.

10.stem_plain: Uncle Ken told the triplets and me to share the cost of the dinner among ________.

1.note: 根据后半句的 并列成分 putting 可知，此处应当使用现在分词形式保持结构平行一致（notice sb doing sth，强调动作正在进行），故选 taking。
1.concept: 平行结构与非谓语动词 — Parallelism & Participles — notice someone doing something
1.zh: 艾玛注意到她的弟弟正从罐子里拿走最后一块饼干并放进他的便当盒里。

2.note: regardless of 为固定搭配，意为“不管、不顾、不经意”。其他选项如 despite（尽管）后面直接接名词，不需要加 of。
2.concept: 固定搭配与介词短语 — Prepositional Phrases — regardless of
2.zh: 孩子们继续进行他们的亲近自然徒步旅行，不管天气如何。

3.note: 在以 I am ... 开头的肯定陈述句中，其对应的反义疑问句的标准习惯用法是 aren't I? 故选择 aren't。
3.concept: 特殊反义疑问句 — Tag Questions — I am
3.zh: “我是个这么乐于助人的朋友，不是吗？”希拉炫耀道。

4.note: 由 neither... nor... 连接并列主语时，谓语动词形式遵循“就近原则”，即与靠近它的 the twins（复数）保持一致；再结合时间状语 this weekend（这周末），表示当前计划，用复数形式 are。
4.concept: 主谓一致 — Subject-Verb Agreement — neither... nor... proximity rule
4.zh: 汤姆和那对双胞胎本周末都不参加训练营。

5.note: work（工作、活计）是不可数名词，不能用 few 修饰；any 通常用于否定句或疑问句。根据因果关系“由于参加活动的人变少了”，可以推断出志愿者要做的活“变少了/几乎没有了”，用表示否定含义的 little 最合适。
5.concept: 量词与名词修饰 — Quantifiers — little with uncountable nouns
5.zh: 由于参加活动的人较少，志愿者们几乎没有什么工作要做。

6.note: between ... and ... 是固定搭配，意为“在……和……之间”，句中有 clear 的并列对象 the river and the playground，故选 between。
6.concept: 方位介词与固定搭配 — Prepositions — between ... and ...
6.zh: 小路延伸在河流和操场之间。

7.note: Felix 与 listen 之间是主动关系，此处需要使用分词短语作状语。由于“听说明”这个动作发生在“完成任务（completed）”之前，因此用现在分词的完成时态（having + 过去分词）表示动作的先后顺序，故选 having listened。
7.concept: 非谓语动词作状语 — Perfect Participle Clauses — having done
7.zh: 菲力克斯在仔细听了说明之后，毫无差错地完成了这项任务。

8.note: 后面有最高级常伴随的限定范围 we had ever put up（我们有史以来表现出的），因此必须使用形容词的最高级 the best，意为“最出色的一次”。
8.concept: 最高级 — Superlatives — the best with ever
8.zh: 我们地板球队员的表现太棒了。事实上，这是我们有史以来表现最出色的一次。

9.note: By the time 引导的时间状语从句若使用一般过去时（were seated），主句的动作通常发生在过去之过去，因此主句应该使用过去完成时（had + 过去分词），故选 had tuned。
9.concept: 时态综合 — Tense — past perfect tense with 'by the time'
9.zh: 到观众们就座的时候，乐师们已经调好了他们的乐器。

10.note: Ken 叔叔是对“三胞胎和我（the triplets and me）”说话，这些人在语义里等同于第一人称复数“我们（we）”。在这个多人群体内部平分费用，对应的反身代词应当是 ourselves（我们自己），意为“在我们自己之间平摊”。
10.concept: 反身代词 — Reflexive Pronouns — ourselves
10.zh: 肯叔叔让三胞胎和我平摊晚饭的费用。

11.stem_plain: The family received a ________ electricity bill after using the air-conditioner every day during the holidays.

12.stem_plain: During Art class, Audrey ________ an old lighthouse before adding colours to her drawing.

13.stem_plain: After the café introduced inexpensive set meals, business ________ quickly.

14.stem_plain: Due to the monsoon, the village was ________ by flood waters, making travel impossible.

15.stem_plain: After weeks of intense training, the soldiers were ________ to walking long distances and no longer found it tiring.

11.zh: 由于在假期里每天使用空调，这个家庭收到了一张数额巨大的电费账单。
11.note: ‘hefty’意思是（数额）巨大的、沉重的，常用来形容异常昂贵的账单或高额罚款。

choices.eg: The company faced a hefty fine for violating environmental rules.

choices.zh: 昂贵的，代价高的 (通常修饰物品或过错)
choices.eg: Buying a luxury sports car can be a very costly choice.
The store had to make drastic changes to improve its sales.
The charity received a substantial donation from an anonymous businessman.

12.zh: 在美术课上，奥德丽在给画作上色之前先勾勒了一座旧灯塔的草图。
12.note: ‘sketched’指用铅笔等画素描或草图，通常是绘图和上色前的第一步。

choices.zh: 草草记下 (常与 down 连用)
choices.eg: He jotted down the phone number on a small piece of paper.
The child placed a piece of thin paper over the picture and traced it.

choices.zh: 胡乱涂画 (通常指无意识地乱画)
choices.eg: She doodled in her notebook while waiting for the long meeting to start.
The artist sketched the beautiful landscape before beginning to paint.

13.zh: 在这家咖啡馆推出了便宜的套餐后，生意迅速兴隆起来。
13.note: ‘took off’是短语动词，在这里的意思是（事业或生意）迅速好转、腾飞、兴隆。

choices.eg: Her career as a singer took off after she won the national contest.
The assistant manager took over the office duties when the boss left.
Young Michael takes after his father with his love for baseball.
The police officer took down the statements given by the eyewitnesses.

14.zh: 由于季风季节的影响，村庄被洪水淹没，导致无法出行。
14.note: ‘inundated’意思是泛滥、淹没，是形容洪水侵袭区域的最专业词汇。

choices.eg: A strange man intruded into their private party without an invitation.
The thick winter coat insulated him well from the freezing wind.
The sudden heavy downpour inundated the low-lying streets with water.
All the medical waste from the local clinic was incinerated safely.

15.zh: 经过几周的紧张训练，士兵们已经习惯了长途步行，不再觉得累了。
15.note: ‘accustomed’常与 to 连用（be accustomed to doing something），意思是“习惯于某事”。

choices.zh: 暴露于，遭受 (通常与 to 连用)
choices.eg: Skin should not be exposed to the harsh sun for too long without protection.

choices.zh: 致力于，奉献给 (通常与 to 连用)
choices.eg: She dedicated her life to helping poor children get a good education.

choices.zh: 承诺，尽责于 (通常与 to 连用)
choices.eg: The government is committed to improving the public transport system.

choices.zh: 习惯于 (通常与 to 连用)
choices.eg: She quickly grew accustomed to the cold climate of northern Canada.

16.note: 近义词替换 — 互惠的/相互的

choices.eg: Respect is essential for building a strong, mutual friendship.
The billionaire made a very generous donation to the local hospital.
A balanced diet and regular exercise are beneficial to health.
In many countries, primary education is compulsory for all children.

17.note: 近义词替换 — 敦促/鼓励

choices.eg: The supervisor told the workers to complete the task by noon.
The doctor strongly urged the patient to quit smoking immediately.
The driving teacher instructed her to turn left at the intersection.
The customer requested a refund for the damaged product.

18.note: 上下文语境 — 迷茫/无助的

choices.eg: The police are searching for a little boy who went missing yesterday.
She felt completely helpless when her car broke down on the highway.
Old people are often more vulnerable to winter flu viruses.
The incompetent manager was blamed for the company's financial failure.

19.note: 近义词替换 — 困境/进退两难的局面

choices.eg: He ran into some financial trouble after losing his job.
We need to evaluate the current economic situation very carefully.
Mary faced a difficult dilemma of choosing between her career and family.
Our primary business is supplying high-quality fresh vegetables.

20.note: 近义词替换 — 很少/罕见地

choices.eg: He rarely watches television because he prefers reading books.
The shuttle bus runs irregularly during weekends and public holidays.
This antique vase is supposedly worth thousands of dollars.
We occasionally go out for dinner on special family occasions.

cloze: Tom was known for thinking only of himself. Whenever his classmates shared their snacks or offered to help him, he would accept their kindness - without ever returning the favour. His grandmother often reminded him that kindness should be [Q16 (reciprocal)] and not taken for granted, but Tom paid little attention.

One afternoon, Tom was [Q17 (encouraged)] by his teacher to stay behind after school to help decorate the hall for Friendship Day. Thinking it would be boring, he refused and left school instead. A few days later, Tom realised that he had left his project file on a bus. Panic filled his heart as the project was due that morning. He searched everywhere but could not find it. Feeling [Q18 (lost)], he sat quietly at his desk, unsure of what to do.
To his surprise, several classmates offered to help. One shared his notes while another explained his [Q19 (predicament)] to the teacher. Their willingness to help left Tom deeply touched.

That afternoon, Tom reflected on what had happened. He realised that others had always shown him kindness, but he had [Q20 (seldom)] done the same. Feeling ashamed, he vowed to change his behaviour from that day onwards.
zh: 汤姆以自私自利而闻名。每当他的同学分享零食或主动帮助他时，他都会接受他们的好意——却从未给予回报。他的祖母经常提醒他，善意应该是[Q16 (互惠的/相互的)]，而不应该被视为理所当然，但汤姆却不以为意。
一天下午，汤姆被老师[Q17 (劝说/鼓励)]在放学后留下来，帮忙布置友谊节的大厅。他觉得这很无趣，于是拒绝并离开了学校。几天后，汤姆意识到他把自己的项目文件忘在公交车上了。由于项目必须在今天早上提交，他的心中充满了恐慌。他找遍了所有地方却一无所获。感到[Q18 (迷茫/无助)]的他静静地坐在课桌前，不知所措。
令他惊讶的是，几位同学主动提出帮忙。一个人分享了他的笔记，而另一个人向老师解释了他的[Q19 (窘境/困境)]。他们乐于助人的精神让汤姆深受感动。
那天下午，汤姆反思了所发生的一切。他意识到别人总是向他展现善意，而自己却[Q20 (很少)]这样做。他感到羞愧，并誓言从那天起改变自己的行为。

21.stem_plain: "Carry Everything in Style." The purpose of this statement in the poster is to ________.

options.2: highlight that the bag is useful and trendy
options.3: encourage students to care about how they look
options.4: remind students of what they must carry to school

22.stem_plain: Why was Ansel featured in the poster?

options.1: He appears to be a good student.
options.2: Most school bag users are around his age.
options.3: His review was short enough to fit into the poster.
options.4: What he said supports the claims made in the poster.

23.stem_plain:
Based on the poster, which of the following statements are true about the Peaks school bag?
A: The bag is small and light.
B: The bag comes in different colours.
C: The bag has multiple compartments.

24.stem_plain: What is the main message of the informational text about school bag weight?

options.1: Students should take measures to protect their backs.
options.2: Students should choose school bags with more features.
options.3: Students should express their personality and personal style.
options.4: Students should use lockers or desks to store their belongings.

25.stem_plain: The poster and the informational text express differing views on whether ________.

options.1: students can store certain items in school
options.2: school bags should look appealing to students
options.3: school bags can fit everything needed for school
options.4: students should fit everything into their school bags

21.note: “Carry Everything”强调了背包的容量与实用功能，“in Style”强调了其时尚的外观设计，两部分结合表明背包既实用又时尚。因此选择选项2。

22.note: 安塞尔（Ansel）的学生证言提到背包非常装得下且容易拿取物品，这直接印证了海报上方宣称的“容量大”、“分类井井有条”等卖点。因此选择选项4。

23.note: 海报中明确提到“Wide range of colours to choose from”（说明B正确）以及“specific space for everything”（说明有多个隔层，C正确）；海报未提及背包“轻小”（A错误）。因此选择选项3。

24.note: 信息类文本主要围绕书包过重会引发背部酸痛和长期坐姿问题展开，并提出了减重、保护背部的具体建议。其核心主旨是呼吁学生采取措施保护背部。因此选择选项1。

25.note: 海报（文本1）鼓励学生“把一整天的学校用品都装进一个包里”；而信息类文本（文本2）则反问“虽然把所有东西装进一个包里看起来很让人兴奋，但你考虑过重量吗？”并劝阻这种行为。因此两文在“学生是否应该把所有东西都塞进书包”这一点上持不同看法。因此选择选项4。
25.concept: 跨文本比较与观点辨析

26.note: “environments where everyone feels supported...” 意为“每个人都能感受到支持与关爱的环境”，用关系副词where修饰表示地点的先行词environments并在从句中作地点状语。

27.note: 此处修饰前面的复数名词“organisations”，且在从句中作主语，引导限制性定语从句，选项中which可以指代物。

28.note: “These include...” 意为“这些（项目）包括……”，用复数指示代词these指代上文提到的“programmes”。

29.note: “through simple daily activities” 意为“通过简单的日常活动”，用介词through表示方式和途径。

30.note: “the foundation of...” 意为“……的基石/基础”，由of短语特指，因此前面加定冠词the。

31.note: “love, respect and care” 为三个并列的名词词组，在最后两个词之间使用and连接。

32.note: “over time” 为固定短语，意为“随着时间的推移”。

33.note: “in their busy lives” 意为“在他们忙碌的生活中”，their指代前文的“people”。

34.note: “connect more often” 意为“更频繁地联系/沟通”，根据上下文“慢下来并多加联系”的语境，此处填more修饰often构成比较级。

35.concept: 介词搭配/非谓语动词伴随
35.note: “By strengthening family ties...” 意为“通过增强家庭纽带”，用介词by接动名词表示通过某种手段或方式。

cloze: Families for Life is a national movement in Singapore that encourages strong and happy families. It helps families build close relationships and create caring environments [Q26] everyone feels supported and loved.

It works with schools, community groups and organisations [Q27] run programmes that strengthen family bonds. [Q28] include parenting workshops, family bonding days and talks that help parents and children communicate better.

Families for Life encourages families to spend quality time together [Q29] simple daily activities like meals and conversations. It believes that strong families are [Q30] foundation of a caring and united society in Singapore. The movement promotes values such as love, respect [Q31] care to help families stay close and supportive. It helps families handle challenges together and grow stronger [Q32] time.

Families for Life organises events and campaigns to remind people to put family first in [Q33] busy lives. In today's fast-paced world, it encourages families to slow down and connect [Q34] often. It shares real-life stories that inspire others to value family time and relationships.

[Q35] strengthening family ties, Families for Life helps build a kinder and more caring Singapore. It reminds everyone that strong families are the heart of society and that small daily actions can make relationships stronger and more meaningful over time.
zh: “家庭至上”（Families for Life）是新加坡的一项全国性运动，旨在鼓励建立坚固而幸福的家庭。它帮助家庭建立亲密的关系，并创造一个让每个人都能感受到支持与关爱的环境。
它与学校、社区团体和组织合作，共同开展加强家庭纽带的活动。这些活动包括育儿工作坊、家庭凝聚日以及帮助父母与孩子更好沟通的讲座。
“家庭至上”鼓励家庭通过一同进餐和聊天等简单的日常活动，共同度过高质的时光。它认为，坚固的家庭是新加坡充满关怀和团结的社会的基础。这项运动倡导爱、尊重和关怀等价值观，以帮助家庭保持亲密和互相支持。它帮助家庭共同应对挑战，并随着时间的推移变得更加坚强。
“家庭至上”组织各种活动和宣传，提醒人们在忙碌的生活中把家庭放在第一位。在当今快节奏的世界中，它鼓励家庭慢下来，更频繁地沟通。它分享真实的故事，激励他人珍惜家庭时光和亲情关系。
通过增强家庭纽带，“家庭至上”有助于建立一个更加友善、更具关怀的新加坡。它提醒每个人，坚固的家庭是社会的核心，随着时间的推移，小小的日常行动可以让关系变得更牢固、更有意义。

36.stem_plain: Since she wanted to serprise everyone

39.stem_plain: A strange smell soon drifts through

42.stem_plain: the cake was as a rock.

36.note: 拼写错误，应将 serprise 改为正确的拼写 surprise（使惊奇、让……惊喜）。

37.note: 拼写错误，应将表示食材、原料的 ingridents 纠正为 ingredients。

38.note: 拼写错误，此处表示被电视节目“分心”，应将 deestrackted 纠正为 distracted。

39.note: 整篇故事采用过去时态叙述，动词 drifts 应用过去式形式 drifted。

40.note: 此处为现在分词短语作伴随状语，表示黛西主动“意识到”事情不对劲，应将过去分词 Realised 改为 Realising。

41.concept: 词形变化 (形容词化分词)
41.note: 此处应用过去分词作定语修饰名词 cake，表示“烤焦的蛋糕”，应将动词原形 burn 改为 burnt 或 burned。

42.note: 此处表示蛋糕像石头一样硬，应使用固定明喻结构“as hard as a rock”或“was like a rock”，由于只下划线了 as，故应改为 like。

43.note: 拼写错误，应将副词“立刻、马上”的拼写 instentli 纠正为 instantly。

44.note: 拼写错误，应将表示“承认、坦白”的动词过去式 konffesed 纠正为 confessed。

45.note: 语境逻辑错误，此处表示一时疏忽“可能会”毁掉数小时的努力，应用情态动词 could 或 would 代替 should。

cloze: Daisy was excited to bake a chocolate cake for her mother's birthday. Since she wanted to [Q36(serprise)] everyone, she insisted on working alone in the kitchen. She measured the [Q37(ingridents)], mixed the batter and placed the cake into the oven. Although the recipe clearly stated that the cake should be checked after thirty minutes, Daisy became [Q38(deestrackted)] by her favourite television show.

A strange smell soon [Q39(drifts)] through the house. [Q40(Realised)] something was wrong, Daisy rushed into the kitchen and pulled open the oven door. Thick smoke escaped as she stared at the [Q41(burn)] cake in disbelief. The once-smooth surface had turned black, and the cake was [Q42(as)] a rock. Her excitement disappeared [Q43(instentli)].

When her mother comforted her, Daisy [Q44(konffesed)] that she should have stayed focused instead of leaving the kitchen. She learnt that even a small moment of carelessness [Q45(should)] ruin hours of hard work. She promised to be more responsible in the future.
zh: 黛西很高兴能为妈妈的生日烤一个巧克力蛋糕。因为她想给大家一个惊喜，所以她坚持一个人在厨房里忙活。她称量了原料，搅拌好面糊，然后把蛋糕放进烤箱。虽然食谱上清楚地写着蛋糕应该在三十分钟后检查，但黛西被她最喜欢的电视节目吸引了注意力，分心了。
很快，一股奇怪的味道在房子里飘散开来。意识到情况不妙，黛西冲进厨房，拉开了烤箱门。当她难以置信地盯着烤焦的蛋糕时，浓烟冒了出来。原本光滑的表面已经变黑，蛋糕变得像石头一样硬。她的兴奋感顿时消失得无影无踪。
当妈妈安慰她时，黛西承认自己本该保持专注，而不是离开厨房。她明白，哪怕是一小会儿的粗心大意，也可能会毁掉数小时的辛勤努力。她保证以后会更加认真负责。

46.concept: 被动语态/动词词义辨析
46.note: It is held every four years 意为“每四年举办一次”，主语为单数代词 It（指代世界杯），使用被动语态，填过去分词 held。

47.concept: 动词固定短语/历史事实
47.note: The tournament started/began in 1930 意为这项赛事“开始于”1930年，叙述过去发生的历史事实，动词用过去式形式。

48.note: The World Cup has grown/evolved into a global event 意为世界杯已经“成长/发展”成为一项全球性赛事，与 has 构成现在完成时，故填过去分词形式。

49.note: Teams worldwide/globally take part in... 意为“全世界的/世界各地的”球队参加预选赛。也可用 worldwide 或 globally 作为后置修饰，最符合语法和习惯搭配的是 Teams worldwide。

50.concept: 代词/形容词与名词呼应
50.note: their favourite teams from the stadiums, and their counterparts/others watching... 此处根据破折号后文的解释，填 counterparts（对应的人，即主场外的观众）最为高级，普通参考答案亦常用 others 来指代“其他人（电视机前的观众）”。

51.concept: 动词固定短语/连词搭配
51.note: bring people together 意为“把人们聚集在一起/团结起来”，与 help to bring people 连用，符合世界杯促进团结的语境。

52.concept: 名词词义辨析/固定搭配
52.note: celebrate their shared love/passion of football 意为庆祝他们对足球共同的“热爱/激情”，love 或 passion 均符合语境。

53.concept: 形容词/限定词词义辨析
53.note: learn more about different/other cultures 意为了解更多关于“不同的/其他的”文化和传统。

54.note: is both an achievement and logistical challenge 意为“既是”一项成就，“又是”一项后勤挑战，与 and 构成 both... and... 固定搭配。

55.concept: 连词引导目的状语从句
55.note: so that they can even welcome visitors 意为“以便于/为了”他们甚至能够迎接游客，so that 引导目的状语从句。

56.note: provide a boost to tourism 意为“为旅游业带来推动作用”，固定搭配为 a boost to sth.。

57.note: represent their country 意为“代表他们的国家”在世界杯上参赛，这是许多运动员的梦想，不定式后面接动词原形。

58.note: They must have/possess/show skill 意为他们必须“具备/展示”技术、纪律和决心，情态动词 must 后接动词原形。

59.note: erupt in/with joy 意为“迸发出喜悦/欢呼雀跃”，erupt in joy 为常见固定情感搭配。

60.concept: 形容词/副词作限定修饰
60.note: more than just/merely a football competition 意为这不仅仅“只是”一场足球比赛，用 just 或 merely 表达仅有的意思。

cloze: The FIFA World Cup is one of the most watched sporting events in the world. It is [Q46(held)] every four years and features the best football teams from different countries. The tournament [Q47(started)] in 1930. Uruguay, a South American country, was chosen to host the inaugural competition. Since then, the World Cup has [Q48(grown)] into a global event that attracts millions of fans.

Teams [Q49(worldwide)] take part in qualifying matches to earn a place in the tournament. During the tournament, players compete fiercely on the field while fans cheer for their favourite teams from the stadiums, and their [Q50(others)] - watching live matches on television. The World Cup is not only about winning trophies. It also helps to bring people [Q51(together)]. Fans from all over the world gather to celebrate their shared [Q52(love)] of football. Many friendships are formed as people learn more about [Q53(different)] cultures and traditions.

Hosting the World Cup successfully is [Q54(both)] an achievement and logistical challenge. The host country spends years preparing stadiums, transport systems and other facilities [Q55(so)] they can even welcome visitors. The event often provides a boost [Q56(to)] tourism and creates excitement throughout the nation.

Football players train hard for many years because the opportunity to [Q57(represent)] their country at the World Cup is a dream for many athletes. They must [Q58(have)] skill, discipline and determination. In addition, they need to work closely with their teammates, as the success of their team depends on cooperation and trust. The final match is usually the most exciting part of the tournament. Millions of viewers watch eagerly as the two best teams compete for the championship. When the winning team finally lifts the trophy, their supporters erupt [Q59(in)] joy. The FIFA World Cup is more than [Q60(just)] a football competition. It is an international event that inspires people, promotes unity and creates unforgettable memories for players and fans alike.
zh: 国际足联世界杯是世界上收视率最高的体育赛事之一。它每四年举办一次，汇聚了来自不同国家的最优秀的足球队。这项赛事始于1930年。乌拉圭这个南美洲国家被选为首届比赛的主办国。自那时起，世界杯已经发展成为一项吸引数百万球迷的全球性盛事。
世界各地的球队参加预选赛以赢得比赛席位。在锦标赛期间，球员们在球场上激烈竞争，而球迷们在体育场内为他们喜爱的球队欢呼，另外一些人则在电视上观看现场直播。世界杯不仅关乎赢得奖杯。它还有助于将人们聚集在一起。来自世界各地的球迷聚集在一起，庆祝他们对足球共同的热爱。随着人们对不同文化和传统的进一步了解，许多友谊随之建立。
成功举办世界杯既是一项成就，也是一项后勤挑战。主办国花费数年时间准备体育场馆、交通系统和其他设施，以便他们甚至能够迎接游客。这项赛事通常会为旅游业带来推动作用，并在整个国家引发兴奋浪潮。

足球运动员多年来刻苦训练，因为有机会代表自己的国家参加世界杯是许多运动员的梦想。他们必须具备技术、纪律和决心。此外，他们需要与队友密切合作，因为球队的成功取决于合作与信任。决赛通常是比赛中最令人兴奋的部分。数以百万计的观众热切地注视着两支最好的球队争夺冠军。当获胜的球队终于捧起奖杯时，他们的支持者爆发出了喜悦的欢呼。国际足联世界杯不仅仅是一场足球比赛。这是一项鼓舞人心、促进团结并为球员和球迷留下难忘回忆的国际盛事。

61.concept: 分词短语作状语 — Having + 过去分词 (Perfect Participle)
61.zh: 看完最新的电影后，沙伦把这件事告诉了她所有的朋友。
61.note: 改写要点：使用现在分词的完成式 Having seen 表示该动作发生在主句动作（told）之前。逗号后面必须紧跟动作的发出者 Sharon 作为主语。
61.answer: Having seen the latest movie, Sharon told all her friends about it.

62.concept: 词性转换与同位语从句 — 动词变名词 (complained -> complaint)
62.zh: 由于林先生投诉打印机有故障，公司予以了更换。
62.note: 改写要点：将动词 complained 转换为名词 complaint。句式调整为：The company exchanged the printer because of Mr Lim's complaint that it was faulty.
62.answer: The company exchanged the printer because of Mr Lim's complaint that it was faulty.

63.concept: 间接引语与被动语态 — 祈使句的转述 (reminded / told to)
63.zh: 教练提醒/告诉我要记得穿上救生衣。
63.note: 改写要点：1. "Don't forget to..." 在转述时通常转换为 reminded... to... 或 told... not to forget...；2. 人称代词 your 转换为 my；3. 主动语态的 the instructor told me 变为被动语态 I was reminded by the instructor...。
63.answer: I was reminded by the instructor to wear my life jacket.

64.concept: 条件状语从句 — 连词 unless (除非) 的使用
64.zh: 除非我表兄弟报名参加比赛，否则他不能去。
64.note: 改写要点：unless 相当于 if... not。后半句 "He has to register for it" 转化为 unless 引导的条件从句，动词注意第三人称单数形式（unless he registers for it）。
64.answer: My cousin cannot go for the competition unless he registers for it.

65.concept: 让步状语从句 — However + 形容词 结构
65.zh: 无论旅途多么令人疲惫，全家人都过得很愉快。
65.note: 改写要点：1. "However + 形容词 + 主语 + 动词" 结构中，原句的被动语态（exhausted by the journey）转换为形容词修饰主语（However exhausting the journey was）；2. 逗号后连接主句 the family enjoyed the holiday。
65.answer: However exhausting the journey was, the family enjoyed the holiday.

66.note:
1. 题型：直接原因提取题——考查学生精确定位到第2段并提取核心心理解释的能力（1分）。
  2. 得分点：答出他的心思都在那天下午的班际足球赛上（his mind was on the inter-class football match that afternoon）。
  3. 失分点：回答过于宽泛或照抄不相关句子。
66.answer: His mind was on the inter-class football match that afternoon.

67.note:
1. 题型：严格字数限定词组提取题——考查从指定行数（5-8行）中提取精确“三个单词”词组的能力（1分）。
  2. 得分点：必须是行7中精确对应的三个单词：nodded absent-mindedly。
  3. 失分点：字数不符或包含多余标点和连带词。

69.note:
1. 题型：双要素提取题——从14-18行中提炼出林老师提及的、能让作者意识到卡片重要性的两点说明（2分）。
  2. 得分点：1分归于指出they were written with care（它们是用心写出来的）；另1分归于指出对某些居民而言those messages mean a lot / mean a lot to them（那些信息对某些居民来说意义重大）。
  3. 失分点：提取了错误的事实（如写成了有些关怀袋不完整、我们要花时间整理等连带麻烦）。
69.answer: Mrs Lim mentioned that the cards were written with care and that those messages meant a lot to some residents.

70.note:
1. 题型：心理起因推断题——分析作者在林老师讲话后产生内疚心理的根本语境触发点（1分）。
  2. 得分点：答出他意识到是因为自己没有捡起卡片，导致了some care bags were incomplete and several residents did not receive their greeting cards（一些居民没能收到贺卡，给林老师带来了额外负担和麻烦）。
  3. 失分点：单纯照抄19行的心理状态描写。
70.answer: He realised that his actions of knocking over the cards and walking away had caused some care bags to be incomplete, meaning several elderly residents did not receive their greeting cards.

71.note:
1. 题型：代词指代还原题——精准返回上下文锁定特定名词或具体概念的完整指代（2分）。
  3. them (行 7)：结合前一句中老师的话“every item in the care bag is important”，明确指代 every item in the care bag / the items in the care bags。
  5. it (行 21)：结合前一句“While everyone else had taken the project seriously, I had treated it as an inconvenience”，指向前文大家对待的任务，即 the (Community Care Day) project / packing care bags for elderly residents。
  6. 失分点：还原范围不精确。

answer.71a: Every item in the care bag

72.note:
1. 题型：判断正误并说明理由题——考查对文本细节的深度核实与精准推断（3分）。
  3. a) 小题：False。理由：文章第20-21行明确指出“While everyone else had taken the project seriously, I had treated it as an inconvenience”，说明他起初只是应付和当做麻烦，没有认真对待。
  5. b) 小题：False。理由：第26行写着作者承认错误后“Mrs Lim smiled”（林老师微笑回应），并感谢他的诚实，说明她并没有生气。
  7. c) 小题：True。理由：第29-33行明确说明，当陈老太看到卡片时“Her face brightened”、“called it a lovely card”，并且在她的架子上“several old cards neatly arranged... had clearly been treasured”。
  8. 失分点：判断错误则全分皆无；理由如果提取不全或逻辑不对应无法得分。

answer.72b: The writer admitted that while everyone else had taken the project seriously, he had treated it as an inconvenience and rushed through it.
answer.72d: When the writer confessed his mistake and said sorry, Mrs Lim smiled and thanked him for being honest instead of being angry.
answer.72f: Madam Tan's face brightened when she saw her care bag, she called the card lovely, and she kept several old cards neatly arranged and treasured on her shelf.

68a.note:
1. 题型：行为事实提取题——提取作者在礼堂打包时犯下的具体错误（1分）。
  2. 得分点：指出他accidentally knocked over a box of greeting cards，让卡片散落了一地。
  3. 失分点：仅回答他草率应付任务（rushed through his task），未点出破坏性核心事实。
68a.answer: He accidentally knocked over a box of greeting cards, scattering them across the floor.

68b.note:
1. 题型：深层动机解释题——全面剖析作者没有立刻捡起卡片、而是直接走开的内部与外部主客观原因（2分）。
  2. 得分点：需要全面（fully）回答。1分归于内在的主观渴望，即他wanted to leave quickly for football practice（急着去参加足球训练）；另1分归于外在的客观环境观察，即他环顾四周发现nobody seemed to notice（似乎没有其他人注意到）。
  3. 失分点：只回答了急着去踢球而漏掉了环境侥幸心理，没有做到“fully”而导致扣分。
68b.answer: He wanted to leave quickly for his football practice, and when he took a quick glance around, nobody seemed to notice that he had knocked them over.

73.note:
1. 题型：态度前后对比转变题——考查提取作者在亲身经历前后的观念成长（1分）。
  2. 得分点：必须答出完整的变化过程。即**起初**他认为这些卡片是不重要的/是一种麻烦，而**现在**他明白它们不仅仅是几张纸，而是代表有人牵挂和关心的提醒物（reminders that someone cared）。
  3. 失分点：没有体现对比，只单一回答了现在的想法。
73.answer: Initially, the writer treated the greeting cards as something unimportant or an inconvenience, but after seeing how Madam Tan cherished them, he changed his view to see them as precious reminders that someone cared.

74.note:
1. 题型：情节发展多重维度信息填空题——考查对指定范围（行1-26）内不同主体的行为、神态、以及意图进行精确定位和提炼的能力（4分）。
  3. (a) 林老师要求仔细打包的原因：直接抓取第6-7行老师的原话，即因为 every item in the care bag is important。
  5. (b) 作者当时的反应：定位第7行，指出他只是 nodded absent-mindedly，一句话也没听进去。
  7. (c) 第二天早上老师神态所表达的心理：定位第14行，老师“looking concerned”表明她感到 worried / troubled / unhappy 或者是对于一些居民没收到卡片而感到担忧焦虑。
  9. (d) 作者主动找老师的目的/意图：定位第23-26行，表明他是想要 confess his mistake / say sorry / find out what he could do to make things right and make amends（坦白交代错误、道歉、并寻求做出弥补）。
  10. 失分点：信息提取错位或者在d小题中仅写了道歉而丢掉了最核心的“寻求弥补措施”的意图。

answer.74a: She believed that every item in the care bag was important and needed to be treated with respect.
answer.74b: He nodded absent-mindedly without hearing a word she said because his mind was entirely focused on the football match.
answer.74c: She felt worried, troubled, and concerned that some care bags were incomplete and residents missed out on greeting cards.
answer.74d: He was trying to admit his mistake honestly, express his sincere apology, and offer to do whatever was needed to make things right and make amends.

75.note:
1. 题型：道理总结与证据结合题——考查总结文本蕴含的成长核心道理，并带入对应的实际行动细节进行支撑的能力（2分）。
  2. 得分点：1分归于提取并精炼出核心启示，即making a mistake does not define a person, what matters is having the courage to admit it and making amends（犯错不能定义一个人，重要的是勇于承认并积极弥补），或指出即便最微小的善举也能带来大不同；另1分归于匹配对应的文本行为证据，例如他approached Mrs Lim to confess, joined the volunteers on Saturday, and personally handed Madam Tan a card he wrote。
  3. 失分点：只有生硬的道理说教而完全缺失了支撑证据，或照抄了无关证据。
75.answer: The writer learned that making a mistake does not define who a person is; what truly matters is having the courage to admit the mistake and the determination to make amends. This is supported by evidence when he confessed to Mrs Lim, joined the volunteer group that Saturday to deliver the care bags, and personally handed Madam Tan a card he wrote himself to make her day.

paragraphs.1: 那是学校放假前的最后一周，每个小六学生都在忙着为学校的社区关怀日做准备。每个班级都被分配了一个帮助社区的项目。我们班的任务是为独居的老人打包关怀袋。
paragraphs.5: 当我们的班主任林老师讲解这项活动时，我几乎无法集中注意力。我的心思都在那天下午的班际足球赛上。“记住，”林老师提醒我们，“关怀袋里的每一样物品都很重要。要仔细打包它们。”我漫不经心地了点头。显然，她的话我一个字也没听进去。
paragraphs.9: 放学后，全班在礼堂集合。桌子上摆满了学生们准备的罐头食品、饼干、洗漱用品和手写卡片。为了能快点去参加足球训练，我匆匆忙忙地应付着我的任务。当我伸手去拿另一包饼干时，不小心撞倒了一盒贺卡，它们散落了一地。我快速向四周看了一眼，既然似乎没有人注意到，我便直接走开了。
paragraphs.14: 第二天早上，林老师走进教室，脸上带着关切的神情。“有些关怀袋是不完整的，”她说道。“几位居民没有收到他们的贺卡，我们花了额外的时间来把所有东西重新整理好。”我的胃里一阵痉挛（感到非常紧张）。我立刻知道发生了什么。林老师继续说：“这些卡片看似微不足道，但它们都是用心写的。对某些居民来说，那些信息意义重大。”
paragraphs.19: 内疚感涌上心头。我低下了头，不敢与她的目光接触。一整天，她的话都在我的脑海中重演。当其他所有人都在认真对待这个项目时，我却把它当成了一种麻烦。丢失的卡片是我的错。一种沉重的感觉在我的胸口沉淀下来。那天下午，我终于走向了林老师。
paragraphs.23: “林老师，”我轻声说，“是我撞倒了那些卡片。我没有把它们捡起来。对不起。”她看了我一会儿才回答：“谢谢你的诚实。承认错误需要勇气。”“我感觉糟透了，”我承认道，“有什么我可以做来弥补的吗？”林老师微笑了。
paragraphs.27: 那个周六，我加入了一群志愿者的队伍，为老年居民送去关怀袋。住宅楼的走廊里很安静，只有鸟儿的唧唧喳喳声。在一个住户家里，一位名叫陈老太的老人热情地迎接着我们。当她查看她的关怀袋时，她的脸庞亮了起来。
paragraphs.31: “多么可爱的卡片啊，”她边说边仔细读着其中一条信息，“知道有人在牵挂着我真好。”她说话时，我注意到几张旧卡片整齐地排列在她的架子上。虽然简单，但它们显然被珍藏着。
paragraphs.34: 在那一刻，我明白了林老师的话是什么意思。这些卡片不仅仅是几张纸。它们是在提醒人们，有人在关心着他们。
paragraphs.36: 在离开之前，我递给陈老太一张我自己写的卡片。她慢慢地读着，微笑着说：“谢谢你，小伙子，你让我这一天变得非常愉快。”
paragraphs.38: 她的这番话让我如释重负。沉重地压在我心头的羞愧感开始消退。那天傍晚回家的路上，我反思了所发生的一切。我意识到犯错并不能定义一个人。重要的是有勇气承认错误，并有决心做出弥补。
paragraphs.42: 从那天起，我明白了即使是最小的善举也能给别人的生活带来巨大的改变。
